name: Rikkei Finance SimplePriceOracle setOracleData access control

classification.summary: SimplePriceOracle.setOracleData() had no access control, letting the attacker point the rBNB feed at their own latestRoundData() contract and borrow the whole protocol against a 1e10-times inflated rBNB collateral value.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

Transfer flows in the exploit tx show ~346k USDC, ~297k USDT, ~300k BUSD and 3.03 BTCB leaving the rToken markets, consistent with the reported ~$1.1M.
